request: Check a bolted sensor mast after adding R0.8 mm root transitions. Keep original material, load, mounting and numerical criteria.

scenarios.use: A sensor mast held by a frictional foot and two preloaded axial bolts.
scenarios.success: Displacement <=0.3 mm and strength FoS2; full preload, lock and service stages with converged root stresses.

checks.question: Does the complete modeled mounting satisfy strength, stiffness and local root convergence?
checks.user_impact: Root and mounting deformation can shift the sensor; an unconverged hotspot cannot support a favorable strength ranking.
targets: Mast root, bolt lands, foot contact and base
checks.reason: The declared connection transmits preload and service loads; an ideal clamped mast is a different problem.
checks.acceptance: Original FoS2, 0.3 mm displacement, 10% stress and 5% displacement mesh changes over two consecutive refinements; original contact/equilibrium/quality gates.
assumptions: Equivalent aluminum E69000 MPa, nu0.33, yield240 MPa; axial bolt and small-slip planar contact model.
checks.load_path: Sensor-seat force -> mast -> foot/bolt lands -> contact and locked bolts -> supported base.
checks.load_basis: Original [0,5,-50] N service force plus gravity, two 300 N bolt preloads.
checks.support_basis: Original base support, axial bolt stiffness117000 N/mm and foot friction0.2; no new artificial fixture.

unknowns: Real preload, friction and material calibration remain separate.
iteration_constraints: Only change justified CAD transitions; do not change load, material, mounting or criteria.
